Chandler Corporate Shuttle: Executive Transportation for Arizona's Tech Hub

Chandler has transformed from agricultural community to high-tech powerhouse, now home to major employers like Intel, Northrop Grumman, PayPal, and countless startups in the Price Corridor. With this growth comes sophisticated corporate transportation needs — from executive airport transfers to large-scale conference shuttle programs.

The short answer: Scottsdale Sprinters prices corporate work by the hour. A Luxury SUV is $125/hr (4-hour minimum), an Executive Sprinter is $145/hr (4-hour minimum), and group shuttles run $185-$225/hr with 4-hour minimums, up to 29 seats, and the 56-passenger motorcoach is $325/hr with a 5-hour minimum. A Chandler-to-Sky Harbor transfer is a one-way fare: $225 for the SUV or $295 for the Sprinter, before 8% tax. A transfer is flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off; longer transfers are priced from the drive with the empty return included.

Understanding Chandler Traffic Patterns

Peak Commute Hours

  • Morning: 7-9 AM on I-10, Loop 202
  • Evening: 4-7 PM, especially near Intel/Chandler Fashion Center
  • Avoid: Loop 101/I-10 stack interchange during rush

Event Impacts

  • Chandler Fashion Center creates significant traffic
  • Rawhide events affect 48th Street access
  • Intel shift changes create wave patterns

Our Advantage

We know Chandler's back routes, timing patterns, and traffic triggers. Your executives arrive on time because we understand local conditions.

Rates are hourly. 7+ hours earns 1 free hour, 12+ hours earns 2, 15+ hours earns 3. 8% tax applies. Checkout shows exactly what is charged today and when any balance is due. Tip is optional — 10/15/20% presets at checkout. It is never added automatically.
